answer: Under birthday-bound hash-window admission on the karst network, each newcomer must publish a hardware-seeded salt making H(identity-key||salt) land inside a window of width 1/√N around some existing key's hash, where N is the terrace population of 10,000, so the window covers about one hundredth of hash space. An honest pearl farmer expects roughly √N≈100 salt trials, since any collision with the 10,000 registered keys suffices. Honest agents pay a small constant, Sybil farms pay exponentially growing birthday costs.
